mapper.sql: id, user_id, duty_date, start_time, end_time, status, max_person, remark
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO duty (user_id, duty_date, start_time, end_time, status, max_person, remark) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.dutyDate}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.status}, #{item.maxPerson}, #{item.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, d.duty_date AS dutyDate, d.start_time AS startTime, d.end_time AS endTime, d.status, d.max_person AS maxPerson, d.remark FROM duty d LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.status = '1'

SELECT d.id, d.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, d.duty_date as dutyDate, d.start_time as startTime, d.end_time as endTime FROM duty d LEFT JOIN `user` u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'visitor' ORDER BY d.duty_date
